Release path

Build the small combat loop before scaling to squads and online runs.

Game systems

The rules that connect programming, combat, and rewards.

01 / Program

Prompt-to-plan tactics

The prototype uses a local rule parser to turn instructions into visible range, movement, and aiming rules. No LLM is in the game yet. A free local model is planned for richer instruction generation.

02 / Commands

Unit programming language

Radar, Gun, Drive, Duck, Cover, and Sniper Perch are program commands. They grant actions and conditions without changing the natural-language instruction. Future unit types can have their own command sets.

03 / Fight

Multi-domain units

The tank is the playable prototype. The final roster is planned to include infantry, tanks, helicopters, and boats on sea maps, with squads of up to 15 units and multiplayer arenas.

04 / Reward

Instructions earned by winning

Victory currently offers an instruction and a buff that lasts one round. Future local-model generation and roguelite progression will expand the choices.

05 / Balance

36 distinct stats

Offense, weapon handling, defense, mobility, sensing, and utility each affect a different mechanic. Numbers remain visible on tank cards so players can understand why a tactic worked.

06 / Later

Long-term collection

Planned additions include 3D graphics, a drag-and-drop inventory, broad weapon and armor selection, three-of-a-kind unit upgrades, and cosmetics earned by retiring tanks. Retirement counts at most five wins per tank.
